list: Official 55-trophy PS5 list, frozen 2026-11-18: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden on PlayStation. Names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them, via Exophase and PSNProfiles (the two agree on every name, description and grade). Guides below are written for this entry, in our own words, and cite their sources.

list_sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

roadmap_note: Roadmap built from the official descriptions and the cited guides: 5 story chapters (60-80 hours), then the 100% Completion checklist (about 100 hours), then Strangers & Freaks and cleanup (about 10 hours). PowerPyx rates the platinum 4/10 and about 200 hours; Push Square puts the top end near 300 hours. No online trophies, no difficulty setting, no mission replay, free-roam continues after the story.

trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are done — there is no separate task behind it. Follow the roadmap in order (story, then the 100% checklist, then cleanup) and this will be the last pop you hear. No online play or DLC is needed for it.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PowerPyx — roadmap: earn all other trophies, no multiplayer or DLC required

trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. Play Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1, through to the end and the trophy pops as the mission closes. It will likely be one of your first trophies.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PowerPyx — automatic story trophy, unlocks after the first main mission in Chapter 1

trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. Finish every main mission of Chapter 1 and it pops when the chapter ends. Before you move on, do the balcony meditation with Lucia at Jason's house — it is the one thing in the game that may be missable, and it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PowerPyx — first meditation is missable in Chapter 1
KeenGamer — after the Down to Earth mission, follow Lucia to the balcony and accept the meditation

trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. Clear all of Chapter 2's main missions and it pops at the chapter's end. From Chapter 2 you can play as both characters, which the later meditation spots require.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
GTASpotter — the last meditation needs both characters, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2

trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. Complete Chapter 3's main missions and it pops when the chapter closes. Keep accepting optional missions and stranger encounters while they are offered — several trophy questlines only stay available for a while.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
GTABase — play the story and take optional missions as they appear; many are only offered for a while

trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. Finish Chapter 4's main missions and it pops at the chapter's end. With one chapter left, it is a good time to save by hand — missions cannot be replayed, and a manual save at each chapter boundary is the safety net the guides recommend.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
GTASpotter — missions cannot be replayed; save manually at the start and end of every chapter

trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed, and the only hidden gold trophy. Complete the final mission in Chapter 5 and it pops as the credits roll. After the story you stay in free-roam, the 100% Completion checklist opens up, and everything the platinum still needs stays reachable.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
Push Square — free-roam continues after the story; the 100% checklist unlocks then
PowerPyx — free-roam after the story, but no mission replay

trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. Breakfast Run is a main mission; play it to its end and the trophy pops. No side requirement is attached — finishing the mission is all it takes.
trophies.name: Trust

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
Push Square — unlocked as part of the story

trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. The Cartel Heist is a main mission; complete it and the trophy pops. Heist missions are good practice for the robbery trophies later (bank vaults, armored trucks, gang operations), which use the same escape-and-lose-the-heat flow.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
Push Square — unlocked as part of the story

trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. Child's Play is a main mission; finish it and the trophy pops. Nothing to prepare beforehand — it comes from story progress alone.
trophies.name: Family Matters

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
Push Square — unlocked as part of the story

trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. Headliners is a main mission; complete it and the trophy pops. Like the other mission trophies, it is story progress only — no collectible or counter is involved.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
Push Square — unlocked as part of the story

trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. VCIA Takedown is a main mission at the Vice City airport; finish it and the trophy pops. The airport is also the setting for Catch Me If You Can, so you will already know the layout when you return for that one.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
Push Square — unlocked as part of the story

trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. Operation Savage Glory is a main mission; complete it and the trophy pops. If you are tracking Gunslinger, a big mission fight like this is a natural place to line up five takedowns in one use of Combat Focus.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
Push Square — unlocked as part of the story

trophies.guide: The longest trophy and the hardest of the set, per PowerPyx. After the story, open Touch Pad, then Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion: the in-game checklist lists everything it counts. You do not need literally everything — PowerPyx notes the checklist is closer to 60% true completion (for example 200 of 277 vehicles scanned and 100 of 255 animals studied), but it does demand most robberies, 70 of the 80 challenges, 15 of the 18 card sets and all shooting ranges and drone races. Nothing on the checklist itself is missable, and progress made before the story ends already counts. Expect about 100 hours on this stage alone.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PowerPyx — hardest trophy; checklist is about 60% true completion; 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals
Push Square — checklist under Touch Pad, Progress, 100% Completion; 15 of 18 card sets
GTABase — nothing on the 100% checklist is missable

trophies.guide: Stunts are the jumps, flights and leaps the game logs as you travel: stunt jumps off ramps and bridges (130 in the world), flying under bridges (202), knife flights between tall buildings (40) and base jumps (25) — 397 in total, so you need just over half of them. Open Touch Pad, then Exploration, then Stunt Spots to see the ones you have found, and Touch Pad, Progress, Activities, Stunts to watch the counter climb. Work through the stunt jumps first: they are the most numerous and the easiest to chain while driving between missions.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
Push Square — 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under bridges, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps; track under Progress, Activities, Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: There are 9 activity types in Leonida. Sample one of each — racing, shooting range, drone races, fishing, arcade games, bowling and the rest — and the trophy pops on the ninth type you try. You do not need to win or finish anything for this one; just start each activity once. Most of them double as progress toward their own trophies, so try them early.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
Push Square — 9 activities in total
PSNProfiles — PSN progress target

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are 42 Shooting Range challenges and you need a gold medal in every one. The two ranges are Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero — find them under Touch Pad, Activities, Shooting Ranges. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers to clear for gold, and some stay locked until you meet their condition, which the map shows. Track progress at Touch Pad, Activities, Shooting Ranges.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
Push Square — 42 challenges; Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range (Port Gellhorn) and Griffin Shooting Range (Balsero); three tiers, some locked
PSNProfiles — PSN progress target: 42

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: There are 14 Top Fun Drone Race locations. Win one race at each of them — the same location twice does not count. Some locations charge an entry fee, so keep some cash on hand. Find the ones you have discovered under Touch Pad, Activities, Drones, Top Fun Drones. Learn each course's corners before pushing for the win; a clean line beats raw speed on the tight city courses.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
Push Square — 14 locations, some with entry fees; track under Activities, Drones, Top Fun Drones
PSNProfiles — PSN progress target: 14

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida — winning the same race twenty times does not count. Race locations appear as you explore; track them under Touch Pad, Activities, Racing. Most locations let you hire a car: check its Rating before you commit, and buy upgrades at Mod Shops if you are racing your own car. Spread your wins across race types so you are not stuck hunting one last unfamiliar course at the end.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
Push Square — 20 different races; track under Activities, Racing; car Rating matters, Mod Shops sell upgrades

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Early in the game Cal asks you to catch a Parrotfish over 2kg. Take a boat with a fishing rod to the marked area on your map — there are boats to borrow nearby if you do not own one — and fish there until you land one big enough. The challenge is about the size of the catch, not the number of fish, so keep casting in the marked spot rather than moving around.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
Push Square — Cal asks for a Parrotfish over 2kg; fish in the marked area; a boat with a rod is needed

trophies.guide: Find an arcade machine in Leonida, start a game and play it through to its end. Any arcade game counts and you only need one, so pick the shortest-looking one first. Arcade games also count as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
Push Square — complete an arcade game

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy is one of the side characters with a mission strand of his own. Take his missions whenever they appear and see the strand through to its last mission; the trophy pops when that final mission ends. Andy's strand is Lucia-only, so play those missions as Lucia. If a mission is not offered yet, keep playing the story — strands open up as the chapters advance.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
Push Square — unlocks after completing all of Andy's story missions
GTASpotter — Andy's questline is Lucia-only

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton has his own mission strand. Play his missions as they come up, ending with the mission named Maritime Disputes; the trophy pops when it is done. Character strands like this are not part of the 100% checklist, so they are easy to leave behind — clear them during the cleanup stage if you skipped them during the story.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
Push Square — unlocks after the Kenton mission Maritime Disputes
GTABase — character questlines finish in the cleanup step

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy has his own mission strand. Play his missions as they appear, ending with the mission named Hometown Heroes; the trophy pops when it is done. Like the other character strands, it is separate from the 100% checklist, so fold it into the cleanup stage if it is still open after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
Push Square — unlocks after the Billy mission Hometown Heroes

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Strangers & Freaks strands are the small side stories offered by strangers all over Leonida — look for their markers as you explore and take each strand to its end. You need 8 complete strands. They are not part of the 100% checklist, so the guides put them in the final cleanup stage, but starting them during the story saves backtracking. Note the quest markers with an hourglass: those missions expire, though they do not count toward this trophy.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
GTABase — stranger missions are not part of 100%; 8 strands needed
GTASpotter — hourglass quests expire but do not count for trophies

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy has his own mission strand, built around vehicles: his missions ask you to track down cars from his wish list. Play the strand through to its final mission and the trophy pops. Vehicle-hunting pairs well with Whip It Good, since every car you get into counts as discovered — use the wish list as a tour of rare vehicles.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
Push Square — unlocks after completing all of Randy's missions; Randy's Wish List vehicle locations

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone has his own mission strand, tied to the Kitty Litter Lab locations. Play his missions through to the final one and the trophy pops. Tyrone's strand is Jason-only, so run those missions as Jason. If you are stuck on a step, the lab locations are the thread to follow — the strand is built around them.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
Push Square — unlocks after completing all of Tyrone's missions; Kitty Litter Lab locations
GTASpotter — Tyrone's questline is Jason-only

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY — do this carefully. There are 18 meditation spots. A meditation only counts once the final zen animation has played, so stay until the animation finishes. The first meditation is the risk: after the mission Down to Earth in Chapter 1, Lucia is at Jason's house in the morning and invites you to meditate on the balcony — accept it before you leave Chapter 1, because it may not come back. The last spot cannot be done until you play as both characters, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Track progress at Touch Pad, Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations, and find discovered spots at Touch Pad, Exploration, Meditate Around Leonida.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PowerPyx — potentially 1 missable trophy: the first meditation is missable in Chapter 1
Push Square — 18 meditation locations; a meditation counts only after the final zen animation; track under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations
KeenGamer — after Down to Earth, follow Lucia to the balcony and accept the meditation
GTASpotter — the last meditation needs both characters, after Coffee Break (Chapter 2)

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret has a hunting strand built around a unique animal. Take Bret's missions as they appear and follow his lead to the hunt — the target is a one-of-a-kind animal, not a random spawn, so the strand itself points you to it. Bret's strand is Jason-only. Hunting also feeds the animal-study progress that the 100% checklist counts (100 of 255 animals studied through binoculars), so keep the binoculars handy on the way.
trophies.name: Fair Game

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
GTABase — Bret's Target Decks are part of the 100% checklist; Bret's strand is Jason-only
PowerPyx — study 100 of 255 animals through binoculars for 100%

trophies.guide: There are 18 sets of Collectible Cards scattered across Leonida. Finish any 3 complete sets and the trophy pops. Cards you have collected can be sold at Pawn Shops and still count toward your progress, so sell freely. Track sets at Touch Pad, Progress, Collections, Collectible Cards. If you are chasing 100% completion as well, that needs 15 full sets — the 3 for this trophy come along the way.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
Push Square — 18 sets; 3 needed here, 15 for 100%; cards sold at Pawn Shops still count
PSNProfiles — PSN progress target: 3 sets

trophies.guide: WAiNK is an app on Jason's or Lucia's phone — hold Up to open it — that scans landmarks and curiosities to reveal extra information about them. There are 31 WAiNK landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags; scan any 100 of them. Check your count at Touch Pad, Progress, Collections, WAiNK Locations. Make scanning a habit while travelling: point the app at anything that looks like a landmark instead of driving past it.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
Push Square — WAiNK app on the phone (hold Up); 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures; track under Progress, Collections, WAiNK Locations
PSNProfiles — PSN progress target: 100

trophies.guide: Challenges are the game's in-game feats, listed under Touch Pad, Progress, Challenges. There are 80 in total across eight groups of ten, and you need 50 of them for this trophy. The 100% checklist needs 70, so this trophy pops on the way to A Long Road. Pick the easy groups first and leave the ten hardest for last — the checklist lets you skip them.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
Push Square — 80 challenges, 50 needed here, 70 for 100%; view them under Progress, Challenges
GTASpotter — 80 challenges in eight groups of ten

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Get a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and escape. Work as a pair: keep moving, break line of sight, and use alleys, tunnels and water to shake the search. It is the partner version of a normal escape, so do it when you already have a fast car and a route out of the city in mind — don't try it on foot in the open.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PowerPyx — no online trophies; partner activities are done in single-player with your story partner

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob three shops one after another without ever losing your wanted level — the streak breaks if the heat drops to zero between robberies. Plan a route of three close-together shops, keep a getaway car ready, and move fast between them. If the wanted level clears, the count restarts, so start the streak only when you are ready to chain all three.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PowerPyx — partner robberies are single-player story-partner activities

trophies.guide: A vehicle counts as discovered when you get inside it or scan it, and the trophy needs 100 different ones. It should come naturally during the story, and you can watch the list at Touch Pad, Progress, Vehicles. To speed it up, scan traffic as you travel and hop into anything unusual — the 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 vehicles scanned, so every discovery here counts there too.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
Push Square — discovered by getting inside or scanning; track under Progress, Vehicles
PowerPyx — 100% needs 200 of 277 vehicles scanned

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the slow-aim mode for gunfights. Trigger it when five or more enemies are in front of you and drop all five before it ends. Pick a fight with a crowd — a gang shootout or a mission firefight with enemies grouped together — rather than a quiet street, and line up your targets before you activate it so no time is wasted. One clean run is all it takes.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PowerPyx — no mission gold medals, so fights can be retried freely in free-roam

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: VCIA is Vice City International Airport. Make an unscheduled departure — get a plane off the ground without going through the normal departures. You already visit the airport for the VCIA Takedown story mission, so the layout will be familiar: find a runway-ready aircraft, get it moving and take off. Expect a wanted level on the way out; the trophy is about the departure itself.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
Push Square — VCIA Takedown is the airport story mission

trophies.guide: Rhinos are the tanks. This trophy is about dealing with them — getting into the thick of a tank encounter and coming through it. Tanks show up at high wanted levels and in military-flavoured trouble, so the natural way to meet one is to push the heat up and hold your ground. Bring heavy weapons and cover; a Rhino is not a fair fight on foot.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PowerPyx — free-roam after the story keeps every open-world encounter available

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Pick a jewelry store, get in and out with the goods while staying unseen — no alarms, no witnesses spotting you. Go in quiet: plan your entry, avoid the cameras and staff sightlines, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails, so restart the approach rather than fighting your way out; a clean run is the whole point.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PowerPyx — robberies are part of the 100% checklist; free-roam keeps them available

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank jobs are part of the 100% checklist — KeenGamer counts 22 bank jobs in the checklist, including eight vault robberies — so these come naturally while working toward A Long Road. For each vault, plan the escape first: a fast car, a route away from the bank, and a way to lose the wanted level before you go in.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
KeenGamer — 100% needs 22 bank jobs, including eight bank vault robberies
PSNProfiles — PSN progress target: 5

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, take its cargo and escape with the heat still on you. Trucks run set routes around Leonida, so watch the roads and pick a quiet stretch to hit one. As with the bank vaults, sort the escape before the robbery: a fast car parked nearby and a route that breaks line of sight quickly.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PowerPyx — robberies count toward the 100% checklist

trophies.guide: Visit all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel, so this is mostly a matter of driving everywhere — cities, coast, swamps and backroads alike. Areas you have not visited stay blank on the map, which makes the gaps easy to spot. Pair it with the WAiNK scanning and vehicle discovery while you tour: one long road trip can push three trophies at once.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PSNProfiles — PSN progress target: 52 areas

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: There are 9 gangs in Leonida, each running illegal operations. Rob one operation belonging to each of the nine. Gang operations are part of the 100% checklist too — KeenGamer counts 39 gang operations there — so this trophy comes along while you work the checklist. Mark each gang off as you go so you can see which one is still missing.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
KeenGamer — 100% needs 39 gang operations
PSNProfiles — PSN progress target: 9 gangs

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach, find a spot with a view of the water and order a cocktail. This is a quiet moment rather than a challenge — the trophy is about being in the right place and taking the drink in. Ocean Beach is on the Vice City coast, so fold it into a visit while you are exploring that side of the map for The Goodtime State.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PowerPyx — free-roam after the story keeps every location open

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Take a car and smash it out through the front of a vehicle showroom — the classic GTA exit through the glass. Pick a showroom, build a little speed inside or drive straight at the window, and break out onto the street. Expect a wanted level and some attention; the trophy is about the exit itself, so commit to it once you are lined up.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PowerPyx — free-roam after the story keeps every location open

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a game — follow through on the lane and finish it. Bowling is one of the 9 activity types, so it also counts toward Master of None. Any completed game at that alley counts; you do not need a high score.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
Push Square — 9 activities in total

trophies.guide: This is a partner trophy about doing something together that gets noticed. Play through the partner moments the story offers — shared activities and outings with your partner — and it pops when the right one lands. It sits alongside Hot Together and Retail Therapy as the set's partner trophies, so if you are working those, this one is on the same path.
trophies.name: Personal Best

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PowerPyx — partner activities are single-player with your story partner

trophies.guide: This trophy tracks choices. The description is deliberately vague — it pops as you make decisions across the game, for better or worse. Keep playing and making calls when the game offers them; it is one of the hidden trophies, so there is no counter to watch. If it has not popped by the end of the story, the choice-heavy side missions and stranger strands are the places to look.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
GTABase — hidden trophies flagged in the full list

trophies.guide: This trophy is about succeeding on a second attempt — failing something once, then getting it right the second time. The description is deliberately vague, as with the other hidden trophies. Play normally and retry what you fail instead of reloading an old save: the game notices the retry. If it has not popped by the end of the story, try a challenge or activity you failed before and clear it on the next attempt.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
GTABase — hidden trophies flagged in the full list

trophies.guide: This trophy is about witnessing something strange — one of Leonida's odd, unscripted moments. Keep your eyes open while exploring: the weird encounters in GTA games tend to happen off the main path, at odd hours or in odd places. It is a hidden trophy with no counter, so there is no way to force it — explore widely and it should find you.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
GTABase — hidden trophies flagged in the full list

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Do a melee drive-by: from a moving vehicle, strike someone with a melee weapon and knock them over. Get a vehicle up to a steady speed beside a pedestrian, lean out and swing. It is a deliberately silly trophy — pick a quiet road, keep the speed low enough to aim, and one clean hit is enough.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
PowerPyx — free-roam after the story keeps every open-world act available

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills are dirty money you pick up from robberies and jobs. Launder them through your contacts — the game's laundering route for turning marked cash clean — until $250,000 has passed through. Robberies feed this directly: bank vaults, armored trucks and gang operations all pay in bills you can launder, so this trophy climbs while you work the robbery trophies and the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

sources.name: Exophase — official name, description and grade
KeenGamer — robberies feed the 100% checklist: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across the shops of Leonida — clothes, food, weapons, mods, anything that takes money. It counts cumulatively across all shops, so normal spending during the story already moves it. If you are short at the end, vehicle upgrades at Mod Shops are the fastest way to burn the remainder, and they help the racing trophies too.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garages are bought with in-game money, so this one is mostly a matter of cash — the laundering and robbery trophies will fund it. Once you own a garage you have somewhere to store the vehicles you discover and register, so buy them as you find them rather than leaving all eight to the end.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Scooter Bros is the app for registering vehicles. Discover cars around Leonida — getting inside one counts as discovered — then register 10 of them through the app. Any ten count, so register the first ten you find and keep going: registered vehicles feed into the garage and vehicle-discovery progress as well.
